what: MM1-v0 forecasts for every E206 arm B point (aifoundry1 card 1, 600 MHz), made by the frozen predictor tools/matmul/mm1/v0/mm1_v0.py unchanged; desk; a freeze line for arm B (see forecasts-e206-armB.md)

card.source: the frozen code (CARDS) and its vendored inputs (inputs/gemm_table.json: every card-1 row carries the c1 resident anchors, V 0.517, s_V 1, G 0, governed False; inputs/tables.json: the c1 anchors)

columns: as the arm A file mm1_v0_e206.csv: cycles an op (wall basis, the slowest minion; and the counter mean = wall / rho), rho, the compute floor, seconds a GEMM, W over idle, J over idle a GEMM, lines a shire-op [L2, L3, fresh], footprint MB, the timing simulation's steps a minion a GEMM, note
